name: Input Mapping
summary: Keyboard, mouse and gamepad bindings a player can change, saved between runs.
description: Loads an action map from Config, remembers rebinds in the user's save folder, captures a new binding from any device, and describes a binding for on-screen prompts. Per-player device ownership comes from the engine, so this works unchanged in couch co-op.
nextSteps: Add an InputSettings component to any actor in the start scene; one is enough.
Edit Config/Cookies/input-mapping/Actions.json to add your game's own actions.
Call BindingStore.Save(input) after a rebind to remember it; InputSettings loads it on wake.
